title: A Visit to the Local Farmers' Market

parts.script:
A: Hey Sam, have you been to the local farmers' market recently? It's really lively on weekends! 
B: No, I haven’t. What’s it like? 
A: It’s great! There are so many stalls selling fresh produce, homemade jams, and baked goods. 
B: Sounds interesting! Do they have any local vendors? 
A: Yes, most of them are from nearby farms. I bought some organic strawberries and fresh bread last time. 
B: That sounds delicious! Is it very crowded? 
A: It can get busy, especially in the morning. You might want to go early to avoid the rush. 
B: Good idea! Do you know when it starts? 
A: It usually opens around 8 AM and goes until 1 PM. 
B: Perfect! I’ll plan to go this Saturday then. Thanks for the tip! 
A: No problem! You should also check out the live music they often have. It adds to the atmosphere! 
B: I can’t wait to experience it! I'll take my reusable bags with me too. 
A: Smart choice! Support local as much as you can.
